name: MC
source:
The heroine who has failing grades in all of her 
subjects-- Math, PE ("How did I even fail PE?!"), 
English and Physics-- except for History ("Thank 
you to all the historical fanfiction I read"). One day,
she wished for hot guys to appear and tutor her
in her weakest subject this Valentines.
